name: Cross Channel Pricing Rule
description: Defines the variation in prices across the channels of distribution.

name: Line Price Rule
description: Enforces same price for similar products or different variations of the same product.

name: Custom Relationship Rule
description: Creates a relationship between products based on attributes.

name: Price Change Limit Rule
description: Defines the limit of deviation from the current price.

name: Small Price Change Rule
description: Defines the minimum acceptable price adjustment from the current price of a product.

name: Max Price Change Rule
description: Limits the number of price changes allowed for a set of product-locations.

name: Price Zone Rule
description: Enforces same price across a selection of stores.

name: Pre Price Rule
description: Ensures prices of selected products does not change.

name: Ending Rule
description: Enforces allowable last digits on price points within each price range.

name: Compliance Rule
description: Enforces constraints to ensure compliance with regional regulations.

name: Cross Customer Segment Rule
description: Defines the variation in segmments across the channels of distribution.

name: Competitive Rule
description: Defines competitive relationships for products or product-store combinations.
rule_attributes: [{"id": "Each Product", "value": "Each Product"}, {"id": "Non - Volume Weighted Index", "value": "Non - Volume Weighted Index"}]

name: Brand Rule
description: Defines the relationship between Private Label and National brands or between different brands.

name: Size Rule
description: Defines the size value relationships by making sure larger products have higher prices and also offer better value.

name: Cross Zone Pricing Rule
description: Defines the variation in prices across groups of stores.

name: Gross Margin Percentage Rule
description: Defines the minimum margin to be maintained across products.
